summary: All 3 tests in the Product Overview suite failed. Failures are due to missing elements, zero product cards found, and a test timeout while waiting for product card details.
rootCause: The tests failed because the locators used to find product grid and product cards did not find any elements. This indicates that the selectors might not match the current application DOM or the application did not render the expected elements.

failedTests.testName: TC-001 - Verify grid of product cards is displayed on home page
failedTests.errorMessage: expect(locator('[data-testid="product-grid"]')).toBeVisible() failed: element(s) not found within 5000ms timeout.
failedTests.likelyCause: Selector '[data-testid="product-grid"]' did not match any element on the page, possibly due to UI changes or incorrect selector.
failedTests.recommendation: Verify the selector '[data-testid="product-grid"]' is correct and the element is present on the page. Update the selector if the application UI changed.

failedTests.testName: TC-002 - Verify product card details are displayed
failedTests.likelyCause: No product cards were found on the page, likely because the selector for product cards is incorrect or the product grid is not rendered.
failedTests.recommendation: Check the selector used to locate product cards and ensure the product grid is rendered correctly. Confirm the test data includes product cards.

failedTests.testName: TC-003 - Verify navigation to product detail page from product card
failedTests.errorMessage: Test timeout of 30000ms exceeded while waiting for locator('[data-testid="product-card"]').first().locator('[data-testid="product-name"]').innerText()
failedTests.likelyCause: The product card or product name element was not found or did not appear within the timeout, likely due to selector mismatch or missing UI elements.
failedTests.recommendation: Verify selectors for product card and product name are correct and the elements are present. Investigate if the application is loading properly or if there are environment issues causing delays.

recommendations: Review and update selectors used in the tests to match the current application DOM.
Verify that the application under test is rendering the product grid and product cards as expected.
Check if there are any environment issues causing the application not to load or render elements.
Ensure test data includes products to display in the grid.
Consider adding debug logs or screenshots to confirm application state during test execution.
releaseImpact: High - All tests related to product overview failed, blocking validation of critical UI components.
